replies.text: The credential vault section is the one I'd open first. Most agent setup guides skip where the keys actually live.
The part where you just ask about the docs sounds quietly useful. Congrats on 1.6.0.
The diff sheets and recorded check results are what make this believable. A phone agent that shows its work is easier to trust.
Deleting things. A bad edit I can read and revert. A bad delete can take the only copy.
